title: Leather Nautilus Armor
description: Datapack+Resourcepack that adds Leather Nautilus Armor (mainly for Decoration/Furniture)
body:
### <font color="#dc143c">With the Introduction of Cuhsion's in 26.3 im going to Archive this Project! 
### If anyone wants an Updated version for a Specific Minecraft Version going forward just make a Github Issue for that!</font>

---

I watched [this Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v-aLG5xZVtM) and saw this comment from MalkeTFC: "Now I wish they had added leather nautilus armor for colored options" so i decided to make a Datapack+Resourcepack that adds Dyable Leather Nautilus Armor!

### Recipe:
![Crafting Recipe for the Leather Nautilus Armor its crafted like a Leather Helmet with an iron nugget in the middle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/597a1069fa1e156e0805dcd1fea4ab3e420d3b10.png)


### Furniture Example:

- Gray Dyed Leather Nautilus Armor vs Netherite Nautilus Armor
  
  ![2 Chairs Build out of Dark Oak Shelves as the Frame, Gray Banner as the Back Padding and a Zombie Nautilus with Gray Dyed Leather Nautilus Armor on the Left and a Netherite Nautilus Armor on the right as the bottom padding and sit function](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bee3791ec7f365b1d6d9beaa7d1634213c27deda.png)
